relation_to_g0: G0 (PRODUCTION_GATE_MATRIX.json) is unchanged and remains the research gate for a new fast lane. This matrix judges release readiness of the scoped package with protected RODAS5P as default. Neither gate implies the other.
verdict_basis: Node V01 audit of 2026-11-16 on loop commit 2dc9a2c5 (code identical to 074a5699): 6 axes NOT_MET, 2 PARTIAL, 0 MET. Statuses adopted from audit/R_GATE_PROPOSAL.json after orchestrator review.

axes.criterion: Order, stiff convergence and agreement with independent references for every exposed method on a stratified battery.
reasons: One executed counterexample on an exposed method is enough to fail 'every exposed method'.
Protected RODAS5P correctness was not re-evaluated here; it is neither supported nor questioned by this audit.

axes.criterion: Typed failures, no silent fallback, session ownership, non-finite input and step-size underflow handling.
reasons: Three confirmed defects of the public PeerOde adapter contradict the typed-failure and refusal sub-criteria.

axes.criterion: One documented entry point, consistent options and solution view, capability and refusal semantics, MSRV and feature policy.
reasons: No single entry point exists on the judged head; V03 is the node that would change this.

axes.criterion: Clean-checkout build on the pinned toolchain, locked dependencies, deterministic tests, CI evidence on the judged head, independent rerun.
reasons: A flaky test target and the absence of any CI run on the head contradict two sub-criteria.
The executed reruns support the recorded U numbers; their raw logs were in scratch (copied to audit/raw_scratch).

axes.criterion: Matched-achieved-error work-precision against external solvers per regime; documented, not required to win.
reasons: Executed matched-error data exists only for small 0D/1D problems and, off the judged head, for two sphere problems.
The criterion asks for documentation per regime and does not require a win; three regimes have no run.
All wall figures in the cited sources are diagnostic_only.

axes.criterion: Workspace membership, separation of research code from the production crates, licences, crate metadata.
reasons: Research modules are not separated from the production crate and two crates are outside every workspace command.

axes.criterion: Ledger continuity, no evaluation without executed solver output, pre-registration before runs.
reasons: All three named sub-criteria have confirmed counterexamples, two of them verifier-confirmed.

axes.criterion: 2D, 3D and sphere operators with stated limits and executed convergence and conservation contracts.
reasons: Convergence contracts are executed and reproduce, but the operators are test-only and conservation was not examined.

promotion_rule: Every axis needs an executed receipt on the judged head and an independent rerun. A release remains a separate owner decision.
